subject: Preprod's sign-in page shows no OAuth buttons: auth.spec.ts:24 fails on every deploy and the cause is unmeasured
activeForm: Finding why preprod's sign-in page renders no OAuth buttons

origin.evidence: deploy run 38086859278 on main 38f5a225: 31 passed, 1 failed, frontend/tests/e2e/auth.spec.ts:24 'should show OAuth buttons'

work_items: Card #27: measure why preprod's /auth/signin renders no OAuth buttons, fix the cause, and verify on the Amplify URL
runConfiguration.backwards_compatibility: The sign-in page and the GET /api/v2/auth/oauth/urls response shape stay compatible; feature 1373's split between 'fetch failed' and 'zero providers configured' stays.
runConfiguration.security_tier: high: the OAuth flow. No secret value in any log, commit or report; CSRF and OAuth state handling are not changed.
runConfiguration.operational_rigour: Preprod only, verified on the Amplify URL (PREPROD_FRONTEND_URL). No new AWS resources; any secret or Cognito identity-provider change goes to the operator.

description:
Target: Customer Dashboard (Next.js/Amplify).

MEASURED. The preprod Playwright suite fails 'should show OAuth buttons' (frontend/tests/e2e/auth.spec.ts:24); deploy run 38086859278 on main 38f5a225 had 31 passed and that 1 failed. AGENTS.md records missing OAuth buttons as a real bug that shipped while test-preprod could not fail. Card #17 showed the cause is NOT the stale unit tests it fixed: the sign-in page (frontend/src/app/auth/signin/page.tsx:38-50) renders buttons only for the providers returned by GET /api/v2/auth/oauth/urls (src/lambdas/dashboard/auth.py:1662), and distinguishes 'fetch failed' from 'zero providers configured' since feature 1373.

UNMEASURED, the first step. What preprod's /api/v2/auth/oauth/urls returns today: an error, an empty providers map, or providers the page then fails to render. Each points at a different fix: CORS or routing, missing provider configuration (Cognito identity providers or secrets, which may be an operator action and may not be a code fix at all), or the page.

CONSTRAINTS. Verify on the Amplify URL (PREPROD_FRONTEND_URL), never the Lambda. If the fix needs a new AWS resource or a secret value, stop and ask the operator.

DECIDED (operator, at the opening pause). auth.spec.ts:24 asserts Google AND GitHub buttons, but preprod.tfvars enables Google only on purpose ('do NOT add GitHub here'). The test is to assert the providers preprod is configured for (Google), and GitHub on preprod gets its own card. That holds once the measurement shows whether Google itself renders.

MEASURED CAUSE (2026-10-15). The subject is wrong: preprod shows the Google button. Deploy run 38086859278 failed at auth.spec.ts:33 (the GitHub locator) after the Google check passed, and a headless load of the Amplify /auth/signin today got 200 from /api/v2/auth/oauth/urls with providers=[google], access-control-allow-origin set to the Amplify origin, one Google button and no GitHub button. The page and the API are correct; the test asserted a GitHub button preprod disables on purpose. FIX: auth.spec.ts:24 requires Google in every environment and requires the GitHub button exactly when the providers response the page received includes github. Verified 16 of 16 against the Amplify URL; a mutant returning providers={} fails at toContain('google'), and one returning both providers passes against the deployed page. GitHub on preprod is raised as cards/NEW-card-27-github-oauth-preprod.json. Spec 1407 was not used: the fix is one test.
